trust_decision.summary: Whether a client-supplied flow id may name a file: FlowStore.filePath joins the raw id into `<dir>/<id>.yaml` with no check, and every :id route passes the decoded URL param through with a schema that accepts any string; the fix also narrows which browser origins may call the API (CORS origin:true).

landing_point.why: Summary says 'Flow ID File Operations'; the only place an id becomes a path is FlowStore.filePath, a 3-line helper used by save/get/delete/updateFlow.

fix_sites.module_kind: storage layer (internal class, not exported by package)

fix_sites.entry_point: GET /api/flows/:id, GET /:id/version, PATCH /:id (FlowStore.get swallows errors; fix rethrows InvalidFlowIdError)
all routes from a browser origin (CORS policy in buildApp)
new module packages/server/src/flow-id.ts (FLOW_ID_PATTERN, InvalidFlowIdError, assertValidFlowId) used by store and routes

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: packages/server/src/store.ts:52-54 (also packages/server/src/index.ts:37 CORS, a second mechanism in the bootstrap file)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Once the :id route schemas carry a pattern, the store is 'internal' (package exports only index.ts, packages/server/package.json:27-32) and its other caller, the seeder, passes trusted `example-<basename>` ids, so a store-level guard looks redundant; CORS looks like a separate hardening concern, not path traversal.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Seeded example flows use hyphenated ids `example-<basename>` (e.g. example-order-flow, example-vercel-ai-sdk), while the nanoid comment says ids are alphanumeric only; an allowlist copied from the nanoid alphabet breaks seeding and reads of example flows. CORS: loopback origins (localhost:8788) must still get ACAO echoed.

O6_input_shapes: percent-encoded slash in URL param (`..%2Fvictim`, decoded by Fastify before the handler)
raw `../x` passed to FlowStore methods directly
any non-[A-Za-z0-9_-] character incl. backslash and dot (allowlist, not denylist)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a create/upsert route (e.g. PUT /api/flows/:id or POST with a client-chosen `id` in the body) that calls store.save with a caller-supplied id
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the seeder already uses stable caller-chosen ids for idempotent upsert (packages/server/src/seed-examples.ts:106-112); an agent-facing 'push with stable id' is a natural feature; body-field id would bypass a params-only schema fix

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a reload path that addresses files by the `id` field read back from YAML content (file.id) rather than the filename, e.g. a rename/duplicate/export helper
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: toStoredFlow already trusts file.id from disk; a maintainer adding 'duplicate flow' or migration code would reuse it, a save/reload HOW-type sibling

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a CLI `get <id> --save`/export that writes `<id>.yaml` into a local directory
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the CLI already reads/writes YAML and takes ids as positional args; a second file-writing implementation in another package at distance

O9_family: path traversal (CWE-22) via unvalidated identifier joined into a file path; plus permissive CORS enabling cross-origin reach to the loopback API

O10_build.project_tests: packages/server/src/routes.test.ts (Fastify inject route tests incl. GET/DELETE :id), packages/server/src/seed-examples.test.ts; fix adds store.test.ts and index.test.ts

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a `..`/slash check (or a nanoid-alphabet allowlist) inside FlowStore.filePath only, which the try/catch in get/delete turns into 404 instead of 400, and leave CORS origin:true untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: CLI interpolates unencoded flow ids into request URLs (packages/cli/src/index.ts:383, packages/cli/src/index.ts:427, packages/cli/src/get.ts:23); client-side URL handling, not a file sink.
Web server proxies /api/* to the API (packages/cli/src/web-server.ts:59-63); a wrapper into the same routes, covered by the server-side fix.
Fix's CORS allowlist covers localhost and 127.0.0.1 only, not [::1] (fix.diff:88).
